verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Replit feature for connecting a project to a user's own GitHub repository or syncing changes in both directions. The docs cover publishing, databases, auth, MCP and integrations, and none of them mention GitHub sync. One community post mentions git operations by the Replit agent conflicting with local commits, but that is not evidence of a documented GitHub sync capability. The axis clearly applies to a cloud development platform, so the absence of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sync my project to my own GitHub repository and keep changes flowing both ways
